events.title: Microsoft commits to sweeping AI privacy rules for students. Will other tech giants follow?
events.summary: As the school year started, the country's two largest school districts, New York City and Los Angeles, announced they were putting the brakes on student use of AI for one year, as they study how to best incorporate the technology into education.
